result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual anomaly is a '−100%' discount badge on a restaurant card, which appears to be a data/content error rather than a plausible promotion. No serious layout breakage, overlap, or misalignment was detected elsewhere.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a '−100%' badge, implying the food is completely free. This is almost certainly a data error or a misconfigured promotion, and it undermines trust in the displayed pricing.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values on the backend/client (e.g., cap or reject 100% discounts) and display the intended promotion, such as '€0 delivery' or the correct percentage off.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '€0 delivery' is shown twice — once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below — which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in only one place (either the image badge or the metadata row) to reduce visual noise.
